search.website_text:
# RelicTracker

Track relic weapons, tools, and armor across every job — see what is finished,
what you are on now, and what materials you still need.

## Tabs

- **Overview** — all relic lines at a glance: how far along each one is and which
  jobs still have work left.
- **Relic** — pick an expansion, line, and job for a step-by-step checklist. Your
  current step is highlighted, with notes and a material breakdown when data is
  available.
- **Tracker** — a shopping list for an expansion: what you still need, grouped by
  where to get it, with owned counts from your inventory.
- **Settings** — inventory scope, plugin connections, and optional extras.

## Progress

RelicTracker fills in finished steps when it can see the relic (or a replica) in
your inventory, and shows live owned counts for materials. You can also tick steps
and armor pieces yourself on the **Relic** tab — useful when something is not in
your bags anymore.

The **Tracker** list shrinks as you finish jobs or mark steps done, so it stays
focused on what is still left to farm or craft.

## Install

Add this custom plugin repository in Dalamud:

`https://puni.sh/api/repository/kage`

Then install **RelicTracker** from the plugin installer. **Allagan Tools** is
needed for inventory counts and owned-relic detection.

## Getting started

1. Open RelicTracker with `/relictracker` or `/rtracker`.
2. Use **Overview** for the big picture, **Relic** for per-job detail, and
   **Tracker** when you want a farm list.

variant.changelog:
- Tracker now groups what's left by what you do: Buy, Craft, Gather & fish, Farm in content, One-time steps, and Activities. Prefer the old layout? Switch "Group by" to "Relic step".
- Buy missing materials with Knightshopper: one button per currency (gil, tomestones, scrips, GC seals, and more). In Knightshopper, enable both IPC permission switches and add RelicTracker to the allowed plugins.
- More Artisan craft lists: Lucis, Resplendent, Zodiac, Anima, each job's A Relic Reborn weapon, and the Phantom weapon one-time crafts. Needs a newer Artisan; the buttons appear once your Artisan has the lists.
- Lucis tools: after your first crafter or gatherer Lucis, the rest of that category can be bought from a Calamity Salvager for 1,000 gil. The Tracker counts materials only for the job you pick as your first Lucis.
- New materials: gatherer and crafter items for Supra and Lucis, each job's A Relic Reborn weapon and materia, and the one-time steps for Resistance and Phantom weapons.
- Materials shared by several crafters or steps are now counted correctly, and items you own are only counted once.
- Step notes rewritten as short numbered steps with tips, instead of a wall of text.
- Relic tab shows where each material comes from, wraps long names, and lists the jobs still to do once a job is finished.
- Cleaner look: one Overview table, calmer progress and shortfall colours, and a single Integrations list in Settings.
- Item names show in your game's language.

variant.author: Kage
variant.changelog:
- RelicTracker opens on All Relics, with every weapon, tool, and armor series in one place.
- New Ultimates page: see which ultimate weapons you own on every job, from The Unending Coil of Bahamut to Dancing Mad.
- Pick any upgrade to see a short plan and expand Quest details for the full walkthrough. Armor pages show missing pieces by role or job.
- Materials follows the series you open and groups what's left by how you get it. One-time unlocks have their own section.
- Save Knightshopper lists for eligible materials, missing Dawntrail armor pieces, and supported armor upgrade materials.
- MogVault is required for Materials and live inventory tracking. Existing completion marks still count, and FFXIV Collect can track relics you no longer own.
- Augmented Law's Order and Augmented Bozjan armor now show the right costs, counted per slot.
- Materials lists all 12 Atma one by one, each with the zone its FATEs are in.
- Craft with Artisan no longer starts the wrong list on Zodiac and Shadowbringers weapon steps.
- Corrected material amounts for Crystalline, Chora-Zoi's and Brilliant Alchemist and Culinarian tools.
- Lucis tools now ask for 5 of each crafter's class item, and the Vrandtic and Lodestar fishing steps ask for one fish instead of two.
- Corrected several upgrade guides: Zodiac turn-in order, the Blade's and Manderville unlock quests, Eclipticum no longer saying North Horn is required, Skysteel turn-in NPCs, and the Elemental armor vendor.
- Materials you already crafted into a turn-in no longer show as still needed, and Knightshopper lists skip armor you can exchange or already bought.
- Relics kept only as replicas, such as Replica of the Omnilex, now count.
- FFXIV Collect progress now counts on armor pieces and earlier weapon steps, and Cosmic tool stages no longer drop after relogging.
- FFXIV Collect is now linked per character, so your alts no longer show your main's relics. Your existing link moves to the first character you log in with; link other characters in Setup.
- Setup can clear old hand-made marks from version 1 (hold Ctrl and click).
